title: They look a little cheap but are ok for the price. Like the size.
text: They look a little cheap but are ok for the price. Like the size.. They look pretty pale in my opinion, just as described though, but the package did arrive a little bent. Other than that I guess they are good we'll have to see how they stand with my christmas tree hopefully good, the size is right so I'm fine with it. I'm glad they are multicoloured at least and they will make a good match with the other ones I got hopefully.
